options.rationale: Correct: a /26 has 64 addresses; minus network and broadcast leaves 62 usable hosts.

items.stem: At which OSI layer does a switch primarily make forwarding decisions using MAC addresses?

options.rationale: Correct: a traditional switch forwards frames using MAC addresses at Layer 2.
Layer 1 moves bits; it does not read MAC addresses.
Layer 3 uses IP addresses; that is routing, not basic switching.
Layer 7 is application data, far above switching.

items.explanation: Correct: a traditional switch forwards frames using MAC addresses at Layer 2.

items.stem: Which TWO commands help diagnose a reachability problem between two hosts? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: ping tests basic reachability and round-trip time.
Correct: traceroute shows the path and where it fails.
format prepares storage media; it has no network diagnostic role.
chmod changes file permissions, unrelated to reachability.
grep searches text; it does not test network reachability.

items.explanation: Correct: ping tests basic reachability and round-trip time.
